samples.css: .grinsawl-slot { border-width: 3px; border-style: solid; border-radius: 4px; } .grinsawl-slot.foil-gold { border-color: #d4af37; border-style: solid; } .grinsawl-slot.foil-silver { border-color: #c0c0c0; border-style: solid; } .grinsawl-slot.foil-bronze { border-color: #cd7f32; border-style: solid; } .grinsawl-slot.foil-none { border-color: #888888; border-style: solid; } .grinsawl-slot.foil-empty { border-color: #555555; border-style: dashed; }

excerpts.source:
css = +'.grinsawl-slot { border-width: 3px; border-style: solid; border-radius: 4px; }'
          { 'gold' => Grinsawl::FOIL_COLORS[:gold], 'silver' => Grinsawl::FOIL_COLORS[:silver],
            'bronze' => Grinsawl::FOIL_COLORS[:bronze], 'none' => '#888888', 'empty' => '#555555' }.each do |k, c|
            style = k == 'empty' ? 'dashed' : 'solid'
            css << " .grinsawl-slot.foil-#{k} { border-color: #{c}; border-style: #{style}; }"
          end
          provider = Gtk::CssProvider.new
          provider.load(data: css)
          Gtk::StyleContext.add_provider_for_screen(Gdk::Screen.default, provider, Gtk::StyleProvider::PRIORITY_APPLICATION)

excerpts.source:
css_provider = Gtk::CssProvider.new
  	bar.style_context.add_provider(css_provider, Gtk::StyleProvider::PRIORITY_APPLICATION)
  	# min-height + padding:0 keep the trough/fill from being squashed by GTK3 theme defaults.
  	_bar_base = "progressbar { padding: 0; min-height: 18px; } progressbar trough { min-height: 18px; padding: 0; border-width: 0; } progressbar progress { background-image: none; min-height: 18px; "
  	normal_bar_style = proc { css_provider.load_from_data("#{_bar_base} background-color: #06b025; }") }
  	bar_style = proc { css_provider.load_from_data("#{_bar_base} background-color: #b02506; }") }
  	bar_style.call

  	# Keep the overlaid label legible on top of the colored fill.
  	label_css = Gtk::CssProvider.new
  	label_css.load_from_data("label { color: #000000; font-weight: bold; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-height: 0; }")
  	label.style_context.add_provider(label_css, Gtk::StyleProvider::PRIORITY_APPLICATION)
